title.narrative: A.E.3. Number of staff that have gained qualitative and relevant knowledge and skills to develop and offer the revised/developed study programmes

comment.narrative: min of 25 staff selected and appointed to start w/ ToT programme

01-07-2020: We selected over 25 participants (indicator from logframe) from different institutions and organizations in Vietnam to be trained in the training programs. In output 1, participants assessed the curricula and available training materials; in output 2, they are acquiring skills to update and implement study programs and training materials. Close to 60% has been female. It was not possible to reach minorities with the ToT. VNUA did everything they could to try to meet the minimum, but unfortunately the potential participants lived too far away in remote areas.
We reorganized the ToT structure into 4 tracks in order to maximize the budget available.
1. Horti track is 4 times 4 days and focuses on the technical knowledge and training to run greenhouses.
In 2019 we had 1training for Horti with 27 participants
2. Didactics track is 3 times 3 days and is focused on training the teachers and trainers how to train more effectively
In 2019 we had 1 raining for Didactics track with 22 participants
3. Coop track is 3 times 2 days and is focused on training related to cooperative management, governance, finance
In 2019 we had 1 meeting of two days with 25 participants
4. Business Case Study track is focused on training the teachers how to make proper business case study using the Harvard Business School tools.
In 2019, we had 1 training of 5 days for 16 people.
For track 1 and 2 most participants are the same, but not all of them attend both. The Coop track participants are different to all the others, as are the people in track 4.
29-06-2021: ToT didactics, horti and entrepreneurship VNUA 21 Ha Tay 5 Lao Cai 2 MARD 4 VCA 2 ToT cooperative >25 (from different cooperatives)

- >**10 TVET, HE trainers and > 50 cooperative trainers;( >30% female, 20% minority) have gained qualitative and relevant knowledge and skills to develop and offer the revised/developed study programmes) **

title.narrative: A.R.3. Number of relevant innovations

comment.narrative: 03-07-2020: Long-term strategy has been developed for HIC. Currently, suppliers are supplying quotes for the hardware, and after VNUA has selected the supplier(s), building can commence. It is expected that HIC will be up by July 2020. Job description has been developed for staff. Staff has not yet been selected or trained. Output 3.3. should materialize after HIC is in place and potentially after the Strategic Networking Meeting In October 2020.

29-06-2021: HIC is not built yet, thus innovations cannot start and be shared. It is expected that HIC will be up by May 2021. Job description has been developed for staff. Staff has been selected, still need to be trained in certain aspects. Output 3.3. should materialize after HIC is in place and potentially after the Strategic Networking Meeting in fall 2021. Note from NUFFIC 2019: Apart from hardware please elaborate on other components that need to be put in place to sustainably run the HIC. Key: staff need to be trained in management of HIC, financial management, entrepreneurship and greenhouse technology.

title.narrative: A.S.2. Number of MoUs or other types of collaboration agreements signed (education, private, public, surrounding community)

comment.narrative: 03-07-2020: MoU: this trajectory of worked is supposed to happen after HIC is launched; MoUs are expected with companies for training, technology transfer and research / innovation services. In addition, there will be strategic networking networking organized in October 2020 and it is foreseen that opportunities will materialize there (partnership agreements with companies Dutch/Vietnamese companies). As of today, one MoU has been signed by VNUA with The Netherlands Vietnam Horti Business Platform.
5 influential stakeholders have established strategic partnerships w/ Vietnamese HE/TVET partners

29-06-2021: MoU: this trajectory of worked is supposed to happen after HIC is launched; MoUs are expected with companies for training, technology transfer and research / innovation services. In addition, there will be strategic networking organized in fall 2021 and it is foreseen that opportunities will materialize there (partnership agreements with companies Dutch/Vietnamese companies). As of today, one MoU has been signed by VNUA with The Netherlands Vietnam Horti Business Platform. Private sector companies already invested in the AgrInnovation Center, which is “housing” HIC. Companies are already interested in demonstrating their technologies and products in the to-be-built greenhouses. Note from NUFFIC 2019: elaborate concrete steps in cooperation within the VNM-NL business platform. The Netherlands Vietnam Horti Business Platform is a cooperative organisation of and for Dutch and Vietnamese companies, institutes and governmental organisations active in the horticultural sector. The platform is a unique bundling of forces covering knowledge, technologies and experience of the entire horticultural value chain in Vietnam and the Netherlands. Though this platform, members work together to establish long-term working relationships e.g. through sharing expertise and resources, sharing and commercializing Dutch horticulture technologies. The platform members will be invited to the launch of the HIC and to the strategic meeting. They will also be approached for internship opportunities.
5 influential stakeholders have established strategic partnerships w/ Vietnamese HE/TVET partners + 1 MoU signed
